portrait_identity.version: EXP34 authored portrait geometry 6 with optional project-generated albedo paint
portrait_identity.method: Dedicated indexed facial cage with real orbital apertures, sewn eight-loop eyelids, independent curved eyeballs and connected craniofacial/auricle/upper-neck surface; individually lofted layered groom locks
portrait_identity.quality_scope: Original game identities. Appearance and motion require actual front/profile/rear native review; dimensions are not a realism or attractiveness score.

portrait_paint.source_kind: Original image_gen fictional adult skin-paint references; NOT game screenshots or measured diffuse albedo.
portrait_paint.alignment: Manually declared eye/nose/mouth/chin/contour landmarks; exact thin-plate spline, skin-only area-prefiltered bilinear sampling.
portrait_paint.coordinate_contract: x=original head X/.069; y=(original head Y-1.458)/.184; sRGB output converted once by generator.
portrait_paint.body_tone: Subtract source skin-swatch channel medians, add bounded relative colour to unchanged BODY reference; no whole-face multiplicative darkening.
portrait_paint.scope: Candidate skin-colour mapping only. Generated paint contains residual lighting; bounded transfer is not photogrammetry, anatomy or native-art acceptance.

portrait_materials.provenance: Original numerical colour fields and PNGs;no photos,scans,game textures or third-party assets.
portrait_materials.color_space: Public RGB and PNG sRGB;convert vertex RGB once in Mesh.vertex;do not pre-linearise PNG.
portrait_materials.skin_texture: Neutral microvariation only;regional face/ear/lid/lip colour is vertex-authored,so shared body material gets no painted face.

hair.uv: U across one lock,Vroot-to-tip;scalp is separate geometry.
hair.vertex_buffer: Linear RGB is truncated to uint8 by Godot RenderingServer;all authored lock/scalp samples retain red>green>=blue and blue>=3/255 after packing.
hair.customization_requires_source_reference: Derive median original hair-mask vertex red per source;do not retain legacy .00048 divisor.

portrait_materials.runtime: No runtime code changed by this module. Existing skin/hair/eye roles remain;roughness,SSS and live highlights belong to the existing PBR helper.
portrait_materials.scope: Material authoring,not a realistic-human acceptance result. Geometry,UVintegration,lighting,allvariants and runtime controls need actual native review.

body_profile_scope: Project-authored game body volumes, not BMI classes, scanned persons or a measured Korean population distribution. All variants keep the same 52 rest bones and the 1.70m normalized game stature.

anatomical_surface_helper.method: Pure numerical continuous anatomical field applied to original skin and garment vertices; skeletal attachment weights are retained with broad soft medial-pelvis support.

surface_sampling.scope: Surface extraction density is not a quality rating. Native unclothed torso and joint contours must be visually reviewed.

measurement_method: Actual emitted vertex bands with >0.5 summed Pelvis/Spine/Spine1/Spine2 native weight; includes the displayed garment/skin. Width and depth are original metre-space distances, not circumference or medical measurements.
